purpose: Additional-date verification of unchanged Nov20 forecasts after the Nov22 extension. This is a separate holdout on the same host.

criteria: Report absolute error versus zero, direction, every 0.5/1/2/5 ms category and pair magnitudes for both providers and both baselines. Single check day; descriptive. Retain failures.
